config:
seed: 7

network:
  dss_master: data/ieee13/IEEE13Nodeckt.dss
  pv_systems:
    - pv_634
    - pv_671
    - pv_675
    - pv_680
  load_buses:
    - 634
    - 645
    - 646
    - 671
    - 675
    - 692
    - 611
    - 652
    - 680
  batteries:
    - name: bat_675
      bus: "675.1.2.3"
      phases: 3
      kv: 4.16
      kw_rated: 500.0
      kwh_rated: 2000.0
      soc_initial: 0.5
      soc_min: 0.1
      soc_max: 0.9
      charge_efficiency: 0.95
      discharge_efficiency: 0.95
    - name: bat_680
      bus: "680.1.2.3"
      phases: 3
      kv: 4.16
      kw_rated: 500.0
      kwh_rated: 2000.0
      soc_initial: 0.5
      soc_min: 0.1
      soc_max: 0.9
      charge_efficiency: 0.95
      discharge_efficiency: 0.95

problem:
  samples: 1024
  history_steps: 48
  horizon_steps: 24
  scenarios: 20
  generate_dataset_scenarios: false
  interval_hours: 1
  pv_feature_dim: 6
  load_feature_dim: 2

lindistflow:
  voltage_lower: 0.95
  voltage_upper: 1.05
  energy_price_profile_per_kwh:
    - 0.08
    - 0.08
    - 0.08
    - 0.08
    - 0.08
    - 0.08
    - 0.10
    - 0.12
    - 0.14
    - 0.14
    - 0.14
    - 0.14
    - 0.14
    - 0.14
    - 0.16
    - 0.18
    - 0.28
    - 0.32
    - 0.32
    - 0.30
    - 0.26
    - 0.18
    - 0.12
    - 0.10
  degradation_per_kwh: 0.02
  curtailment_per_kwh: 1
  terminal_soc_tolerance: 0.05

model:
  hidden_dim: 128
  graph_layers: 2
  temporal_layers: 2
  dropout: 0.1

training:
  batch_size: 256
  forecaster_epochs: 500
  surrogate_epochs: 1200
  phase3_mode: alternating
  phase3_forecaster_epochs: 1500
  phase3_surrogate_epochs: 1000
  phase3_rounds: 5
  learning_rate: 0.00015
  joint_learning_rate: 0.0001
  joint_surrogate_learning_rate: 0.00001
  warmup_epochs: 30
  min_learning_rate_ratio: 0.1
  max_grad_norm: 1.0
  joint_forecast_loss_tolerance: 0.2
  joint_forecast_constraint_weight: 0.2
  operating_cost_loss_weight: 0.5
  voltage_violation_loss_weight: 10
  line_flow_violation_loss_weight: 10
  kw_violation_loss_weight: 0
  soc_violation_loss_weight: 0
  terminal_soc_loss_weight: 200

  joint_forecast_loss_weight: 0.0

  phase3_reset_forecaster_scheduler_per_round: false

  phase3_early_stopping_patience: 50

  phase3_early_stopping_min_delta: 0.001

  phase3_validation_interval: 10
limitation: Validation was held out only for phase 3; pretrained checkpoints may have seen it.
